headline.description: the week in one line, ≤ 30 characters: an image or turn of phrase for what mattered most, a little poetic but true to this week's facts, no numbers (in the content language named in the prompt)

summary.description: 3–4 sentences overall: the week's focus, what got done, the biggest problem (in the content language named in the prompt)

title.description: the insight's conclusion in one sentence, ≤ 22 characters (in the content language named in the prompt)

analysis.description: 2–3 sentences of analysis: what pattern shows, and why (in the content language named in the prompt)

evidence.description: concrete evidence: statistics or what the summaries say (in the content language named in the prompt)

so_what.description: what it means and how to take it, 1 sentence (in the content language named in the prompt)

focus.description: what was worked on this week (with summaries: down to features/decisions; without: the shape of the effort) (in the content language named in the prompt)

assessment.description: assessment of progress: how far it moved, whether the output matches the effort (in the content language named in the prompt)

status.description: advancing: moved forward toward its goal; stable: kept at a stable pace, no notable progress or trouble; stuck: blocked, or effort without visible progress; diverging: effort spread over several directions or topics instead of converging on one; wrapping_up: finishing or closing out

next.description: the one thing most worth doing next (in the content language named in the prompt)

verdict.description: the working rhythm in one sentence (in the content language named in the prompt)

analysis.description: 2–3 sentences: what the hours, late nights and long stretches mean, and their likely effect on output and on the quality of judgment (in the content language named in the prompt)

pattern.description: the most visible rhythm pattern (in the content language named in the prompt)

dimension.description: the 4D AI fluency framework: one item per dimension

level.description: strength: a clear strength the data shows; stable: adequate, nothing notable either way; needs_work: could improve, including a gap the data shows or a practice worth changing

observation.description: 2 sentences of observation (in the content language named in the prompt)

evidence.description: the statistics or summary content it rests on; if they can't carry a judgment, say so (in the content language named in the prompt)

suggestion.description: a concrete practice, 1 sentence (in the content language named in the prompt)

action.description: one thing that can be done as written (in the content language named in the prompt)

why.description: which observation it answers, the expected effect (in the content language named in the prompt)
